title: NX workflows and connector status
description: Explore NX workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Siemens

NX

Siemens NX spans advanced product design, assemblies and engineering preparation for complex products.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Model a complex component

Use current feature dimensions, datums and design intent. In the intended NX preview, model a complex component; the visible result is the revised solid and its driving constraints. Review interfaces, retained references and manufacturable intent before accepting or exporting it.

Manage an assembly change

Start from the selected part or assembly revision. In the intended NX preview, manage an assembly change; the visible result is an updated assembly state with affected relationships highlighted. Review fit, motion, access and clearance before accepting or exporting it.

Prepare downstream engineering data

Begin with the reviewed model and release properties. In the intended NX preview, prepare downstream engineering data; the visible result is a drawing, bill of materials or model definition tied to that revision. Review dimensions, revision identity and downstream completeness before accepting or exporting it.
